shareText:
Here is how I learned that knowing you shouldn’t want someone can make the chemistry feel even stronger 👇

You both know the reasons.

You’ve probably talked about them.

You know exactly why crossing that line is a terrible idea.

And honestly…

Then you’re together and suddenly every logical thought disappears.

There’s just that impossible tension between what you know and what you want.

And the truth is —

Sometimes forbidden connections feel so intense because every moment carries the awareness that it shouldn’t be happening.

You’re trying to remember the boundaries while another part of you wants to forget them completely.

Now I understand…

Maybe that’s why certain moments stay in your head long after they’re over.

Not because they were supposed to become something more.

But because for a little while, wanting each other felt stronger than every reason not to.

Follow me if you’re learning that sometimes the hardest chemistry to forget is the chemistry you knew you shouldn’t act on 💛
